capabilities: Render Vega and Vega-Lite charts as a Bases view driven by its filters, sorts and groups
Define charts in agate or vega code blocks from a spec file, base rows, or per-note CSV, JSON or URL data
Visualize vault links and the folder tree as link graphs, arc diagrams, sunbursts and treemaps
Open the underlying note by clicking a chart mark
Generate or adjust chart specs by copying prompts for LLM assistants or installing an agent skill
extras: Makes no network requests by default; loading remote data and API keys are opt-in settings. Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later with the core Bases plugin enabled. Detailed usage lives in an external guide, quickstart and gallery.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn note properties and vault structure into charts, so visualizing vault data means leaving the app.

relations.evidence: Vega Visualizations (```vega / ```vega-lite blocks): both plugins can be on.
With an AI agent that works on your vault (Claude Code and others): give it the agate-chart skill.

summary: Charting plugin that renders Vega and Vega-Lite visualizations from Bases views or agate code blocks, from bar charts to maps, networks and dashboards.
